name: Banana streak disease
symptoms: early_stage: Yellow streaks running from leaf midrib to leaf margin Continuous or broken yellow lines across the leaf intermediate_stage: Streaks appear scattered or arranged in bands Reduced plant vigor and smaller plant size advanced_stage: Yellow streaks turn brown or black with leaf aging Smaller banana bunches Possible pseudostem internal rot and dieback in severe cases
management: cultural_control: Use virus-free planting material Remove and destroy infected plants Monitor plantations regularly vector_control: Control mealybug populations Use horticultural oils or soap sprays Use commercial horticultural oil products quarantine: Follow FAO germplasm movement guidelines for Musa species Use certified disease-free tissue culture plants
sources: CSIRO Publishing – Diseases of Fruit Crops in Australia (2009)
Pacific Pests, Pathogens and Weeds Database
Bioversity International – FAO Musa Germplasm Movement Guidelines
